name: io.github.tonyyang0504/breezy_hr-mcp
description: Breezy HR (jobs): me, search, get_posting. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_BREEZY_HR_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Breezy Personal Access Token (prefix breezy_pat_) from the Breezy app: user icon > My Settings > API Keys > Create API Key; sent as `Authorization: Bearer`. It acts as the Breezy user who created it.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_BREEZY_HR_COMPANY_ID
environmentVariables.description: The Breezy company id (12-14 character hex `_id` from GET /v3/companies) whose positions are read.
